area.bookingInfo: Book in the Hello To Go app, at book.hellotogo.rideco.com or call 403-948-8875 (Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.), up to seven days ahead.

Airdrie.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; Saturday 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.; Sunday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
Airdrie.hoursNote: No service on New Year's Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Heritage Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving Day, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day and Boxing Day.

notes: Stop-based: only stops are drawn, no service-area outline. Stops from 'Hello To Go.kml' (the Hello To Go MyMap: every pickup and drop-off location, bus stops and virtual stops), sent by Tanner Rusk (City of Airdrie, Transit Administrator) to Atlas Outreach on 2026-11-20. The City has no GIS file of the service area; it 'generally covers most developed areas of Airdrie, as shown within the rider application', so no outline is drawn (understate, never overstate). All 262 stops kept, names as in the file. Hours, holidays, booking and pickup from the City's Hello To Go page, retrieved 2026-11-20. Fare is the local fare (the page links to the fares page).
